# Daymark Workspace Guidance

- This is an Angular 19 standalone application written in TypeScript and SCSS.
- The task dashboard lives in `src/app/app.component.ts`, its template, and component stylesheet.
- Keep task workflows accessible and responsive; use Angular control-flow syntax and Lucide Angular icons.
- Task state is stored locally in the browser under `daymark.tasks`; there is no backend service.
- Run the app with `npm start`, verify production output with `npm run build`, and run unit tests with `npm test`.
